status: R19A designs implemented from historical paired and visual evidence; ongoing R18 module comparisons are supplementary, not a wait for full condition matrices

findings.source: R18 G-E own400 matched training; reports/goal_evidence_audit.json
findings.finding: T2V40 PC +0.325, SA unchanged, Joint +1; reader and conditioned FFN both changed, so current evidence supports the combination but does not isolate the source of improvement.

findings.source: R18 H-F own400 matched training; reports/goal_evidence_audit.json
findings.finding: I2V40 PC +0.025, SA unchanged, Joint +1. Do not assume the T2V physical benefit transfers unchanged to I2V.

B400, B400+I and native R15I have exactly the same11 SA-pass cases and10 Joint-pass cases on fixed40. B+I improves PC coverage but leaves the semantic-success bottleneck unchanged; copying the reader alone is not evidence for meeting SA/Joint targets.

Within trained R15I, learned physical Q beats replacing it with native Q by +0.0625 SA/+0.0625 PC/+2 Joint on16. Keep independent query adaptation under consideration; R15I overall failure does not show physical Q is harmful.
Empty or wrong conditions can earn high PC despite severe visual failures. Correct-condition efficacy must be established jointly with SA/Joint and actual video review, not chosen by PC alone.

design_requirements: Separate task-specific input and fusion reasoning for T2V and I2V.
Prefer official-fresh400; train/infer consistency preferred, empirical inference improvements allowed.
Retain effective physics capacity and address semantic/process completion explicitly; do not select based only on zero-init tests or FM scalar values.
Recheck each mechanism decision against actual paired scores and visual evidence before formal submission.
